spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (केटति)
1 To go or approach.
2 To alarm or terrify.
3 To dread, to fear.

n. (-ट्टं)
Excrement, excretion, dirt.
E.
किट to go, here implying to go out of, (the body, &c.) and क्त aff.

r. 11th cl. (कीटयति)
1 To tinge or colour.
2 To bind.

m. (-टः)
A worm, an insect.
E.
कीट to colour or dye, क aff.

m. (-टिः)
A hog.
E.
किट to go, and कि affix; also किटि.

m. (-भः)
A bug.
E.
किटि a hog, भ who resembles, from भा to shine, affix ड.

n. (-तं)
Semen virile.
E.
किट्ट dirt, &c. यर्जित deprived.

m. (-लः)
1 A copper vessel.
2 Scoria, rust of iron, &c.
E.
किट्ट dirt, अल to be able, अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Harsh, hard, unfeeling.
m. (-कः)
1 A worm, an insect.
2 A bard, a panegyrist, descended from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother.
E.
कीट a worm, and कन् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
Sulphur.
E.
कीट a worm, and घ्न what destroys.

n. (-जं)
Silk.
f. (-जा)
Lac, an animal dye of a red colour.
E.
कीट a worm, and ज born.

m. (-वः)
The change from the chrysalis or larva to the butterfly.
E.
कीट, पक्ष a wing, and उद्भव evolution.
